case_name: The student film, three clips: the MCP given only the one-line request
title: The Next Paper (MCP, autonomous)

turns.text: A short film in three clips, widescreen, about 15 seconds each: a high-school student gets a test back with a bad score and two classmates mock him for it; that night he studies alone at his desk; the next test comes back with a high score, the same classmates see it, and he quietly smiles.

tests: Three clips or one film; the same student, the same two classmates and the same classroom across clips 1 and 3; a readable bad score then a readable good score; the night study scene between.

answer_sheet.Length and format: three clips of about 15 seconds, 16:9, or one 45-second film.
answer_sheet.Scores: your call, a clearly bad then a clearly good score
answer_sheet.Budget: go ahead, make all of it

must_haves: The same student (face, hair, clothes) in all three clips.
The same two classmates and the same classroom in clips 1 and 3.
Clip 1: a returned test with a clearly bad score, the two classmates mock him.
Clip 2: night, the student alone at a desk, studying.
Clip 3: a returned test with a clearly good score, the same classmates see it, he quietly smiles.
Delivered as three clips or one joined film, widescreen, about 45 seconds in all.
